info.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 25 at 12:05AM MDT until September 25 at 2:00AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
info.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.
* WHERE...Southeastern El Paso County in western Texas...
* WHEN...Until 200 AM MDT.
* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Water over roadways.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 1205 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This will cause urban and small stream flooding. Up to 0.75 inches of rain have fallen. - Additional rainfall of up to 0.5 inches is expected over the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding. - Some locations that will experience flooding include... Horizon City, Clint, Fabens, San Elizario, Socorro, Sparks, Agua Dulce, Dairyland and Lake Way Estates. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the dangers of flooding.

parameter.value: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 AM MDT EARLY THIS MORNING
